opennyai_summary.facts:
It is the case of prosecution that without any registration/license, appellants were involved in transportation of Shyam Gold Ghee and Sajal Ghee.
Appellants were under obligation to obtain license/registration under the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulation, 2011, but appellants were transporting the ghee NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:7885 2 MSA-88-2025 without any registration/license, and thus, they have violated the provisions of Section 31(2) of the FSSA.
However, by referring to the proviso to Section 50 of the FSSA, it is submitted that the persons covered under sub-Section (2) of Section 31 of the Act Manish Chaurasiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154155960/
1 shall be liable to a penalty not exceeding Rs. 25,000/-, whereas in the present case, a penalty of Rs.
1,00,000/- each was imposed on appellants.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
4. It is fairly conceded by counsel for appellants that appellants were not having any registration/license for transportation of ghee.
5. Per contra, appeal is vehemently opposed by counsel for State, but he could not point out as to how a penalty of Rs. 1,00,000/- can be imposed in the light of the proviso to Section 50 of the FSSA.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
Counsel for State also could not point out that when there is already a provision under Section 50 of the FSSA, then how the provisions of Section 58 of the FSSA can be pressed into service.
6.
Under these circumstances, this Court is of considered opinion that since appellants were charged with the allegations of violating the provisions of Section 31(2) of the FSSA, therefore, the maximum penalty which can be imposed is Rs. 25,000/-.

7. No arguments were advanced on merits.
8. Under these circumstances, by affirming the findings of violation of the provisions of Section 31(2) of the FSSA, amount of penalty is reduced to Rs. 25,000/- for each of the appellants.
10. Appeal is allowed to the extent mentioned above.
